## Neutrinos from pion decay {#pion-production}

:::::: {.panel-tabset}

### Pion decays

$$pp\ \text{or}\ p\gamma\ \longrightarrow\pi^\pm,\,\pi^0+X$$

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="57%"}
**Charged pion and muon**

$$
\begin{aligned}
\pi^+&\to\mu^++\nu_\mu\\[0.5em]
\mu^+&\to e^++\nu_e+\bar\nu_\mu
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
::: {.column width="39%"}
**Neutral pion**

$$\pi^0\to\gamma+\gamma$$

Neutrinos and photons share the pion-production energy budget.
:::
:::::

::: {.media-caption}
Charge-conjugate chain for $\pi^-$ · [Ahlers & Halzen (2018)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.11112)
:::

### Parent proton energy

<span id="parent-particle-energy"></span>

$$
E_p\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim1/5\ } E_\pi
\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim1/4\ } E_\nu
\qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad E_p\sim20E_\nu
$$

| Neutrino | Characteristic parent proton |
|:---|:---|
| $10\,\mathrm{TeV}$ | $\sim200\,\mathrm{TeV}$ |
| $100\,\mathrm{TeV}$ | $\sim2\,\mathrm{PeV}$ |
| $1\,\mathrm{PeV}$ | $\sim20\,\mathrm{PeV}$ |

::: {.media-caption}
Same frame · Negligible pion/muon cooling · A scale estimate, not an event-by-event conversion
:::

### Photons and neutrinos

$$pp:\quad N_{\pi^+}:N_{\pi^-}:N_{\pi^0}\simeq1:1:1$$

$$
E_\nu^2\Phi_\nu(E_\nu)\simeq\frac32 E_\gamma^2\Phi_\gamma(E_\gamma),
\qquad E_\gamma\simeq2E_\nu
$$

**At production:** $pp$ benchmark, all neutrino flavours and both signs.

Photon absorption and cascading modify the comparison with observed spectra.

::: {.media-caption}
[Ahlers & Halzen (2018), Eq. 3](https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.11112)
:::
